maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from recurring broadband, TV and phone subscriptions, plus tower leasing, not repair or replacement of owned items.

publicly_funded.reason: TDS Telecom bills consumers and businesses for internet, TV and phone; Array leases towers to wireless carriers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from fiber build-out and subscriber and tower leasing, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: TDS Telecom supplies essential broadband and phone service in often rural areas, and carriers depend on Array towers.

notes: Array Digital Infrastructure (towers, formerly UScellular) and TDS Telecom are both large, so the larger part is uncertain; the answers hold for both.
